extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants, institutional signing officials, administrative officials, PIs, and grants administrators using the ASSIST application submission system
extracted.subtask_description: Step-by-step operational guidance for preparing, copying, editing, ordering, and deleting components and forms in NIH's ASSIST system when assembling single- and multi-project grant applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copy feature limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: The copy feature will do a best effort copy of form field data. Data loss is possible when copying from one announcement to another due to potential form differences. Application attachments will not be retained. Be sure to carefully check the new copy of the application for completeness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A confirmation pop-up displays; carefully read the warning before continuing. After confirming the copy, a prompt asks whether to remain in the current application (OK) or open the newly created application (Continue).

rubrics_metrics.name: Optional copying of attachments (copy workflow)
rubrics_metrics.description: Optional: To copy attachments, select the checkbox next to the question 'Would you like the attachments to be copied to the new application?' and then select the Copy Application button.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note earlier warnings about attachments not being retained when copying between announcements; verify whether attachments were copied and carefully check the copied application for completeness. Selecting Cancel closes the action without copying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delete entire application — permission and permanence
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are the Signing Official you have access to the Delete Application feature in ASSIST. Deleting an application is a permanent action. Once deleted, the application cannot be accessed, re-instated, or viewed. There is no way to recover a deleted application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To delete: open Application Information, select Delete Application, confirm on multiple pop-up screens (Go Back to cancel or Continue to confirm). After successful deletion the ASSIST login page displays 'Application successfully deleted.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Delete component — permission and permanence
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are the Signing Official, Administrative Official, or the PI of the lead organization and/or you have Entire Application Editor privilege, you have access to the Delete Component feature. Deleting a component is a permanent action; a deleted component cannot be retrieved or viewed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To delete: open the Summary tab for the component, select Delete Component, confirm via two confirmation prompts (Go Back to abort or Continue to confirm). After deletion the Application Information screen displays 'Component successfully deleted' and the Application Status History shows Abandoned with a status comment noting the deletion and user.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cannot delete when forms are locked
rubrics_metrics.description: You cannot delete an application or a component if one or more of the forms are locked by yourself or another ASSIST user.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a form is locked you will see an error such as: 'The application/component cannot be deleted as the following form(s) are currently locked by <User ID> in: <application ID>: <locked form>'. Unlock the forms (or have the locking user release them) before attempting deletion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add optional forms — availability limited to NOFO
rubrics_metrics.description: Only the optional forms available for the specific funding opportunity can be added to the application using the Add Optional Form feature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To add: select Add Optional Form, choose a form from the drop-down list and Submit. Selecting Cancel closes the window without adding the form. For multi-project applications follow the multi-project steps (return to Application Info, expand component, select Add Optional Form).

rubrics_metrics.name: Component types and NOFO-specific requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple-project opportunities often require additional component types (e.g., Admin Core, Core, Project, Construction, Career Development, Training). The component types required for an opportunity differ depending on the Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ASSIST only allows the required component types specific to the opportunity to be added; refer to the NOFO and the Application Guide for details on which component types and forms are required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall component is required and special
rubrics_metrics.description: The Overall component provides overview information for the application, describes how additional components fit together, captures the PD/PI and multi-PD/PIs for the entire application, and is a special component type with a single occurrence in every complex application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Overall component includes full SF424 R&R cover data collection but does not include a budget. It is automatically created when you initiate your application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add additional component types — order and fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Users should add components for a specific component type in the order in which they should appear within the final application image used by the agency. The order of component types cannot be rearranged once they are added to the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To add: select Add New Component, choose Component Type (only those available for the opportunity show), enter Component Start/End Dates (default to Overall), enter Component Project Title, optional Short Name, then Save to add the component and its associated forms. Selecting Cancel aborts without saving.

rubrics_metrics.name: Component short name constraints and behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Component Short Name (optional) can be entered when a component is added or updated later; it must be 20 characters or less and unique to the project. Short names are available only in ASSIST and do not carry over to Grants.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short names appear on the Component Information page and under the component identifier in the left-side Component Type navigation panel. Use 'Update Short Name' to change it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Component Information page fields and status tips
rubrics_metrics.description: The Component Information section displays read-only details entered when the component was added: Component Identifier, Component Short Name, Component Type, Component Title, Component Project Lead, Organization, Status, Status Date. The Application Information section displays read-only Application ID, Opportunity Number, Project Title, PD/PI Name, Organization, Status, Status Date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tip: hover over the status with your mouse for a short description of the status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change component order — rules and syntax
rubrics_metrics.description: The Change Component Order screen sets the order in which components appear in the submitted application for each component type. You can reorder components within a component type but cannot rearrange the order of component types.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter a unique order value for each component (you will receive an error if duplicate values are used). You may use decimal numbers (up to 2 places) and negative numbers to avoid re-numbering (e.g., use 1.5 to insert between 1 and 2). Refresh shows updated order but does not save; select Save to persist changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forms editable only when status is Work in Progress and edit locking
rubrics_metrics.description: Forms of an application (or a multi-project component) can be edited when the status is Work in Progress. Selecting the Edit button reserves the form, enables it for editing, and prevents others from editing it simultaneously.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For grouped sections, editable data fields are expanded by default (Expand All); individual fields can be expanded/collapsed. Complete forms paying attention to validation warnings. Use Save options at the bottom to preserve data: Save and Keep Lock (keep editing), Save and Release Lock (close form), Save and Add (multi-page). Cancel and Release Lock returns form to read-only and does not save entered information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required fields and form-level validations
rubrics_metrics.description: Be prepared to enter data marked with an asterisk (*) as these data elements are required to save the form. Validations exist to ensure that the proper and required information is entered correctly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the Application Guide and the 'Form and Field Level Validations' help topic for details and field-level instructions. For system help with entering data into form fields, refer to specific form help topics in Overall Component Forms and/or Other Components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unsaved-data navigation warning
rubrics_metrics.description: When navigating from tab to tab without saving data, a warning displays: 'Exiting without saving will result in losing the data entered. Do you wish to save before exiting?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Options: Return to the form to save (Go Back), select a save option at the bottom of the form, and then navigate; or Continue to next form without saving (select Continue).

rubrics_metrics.name: Session timeout and keep-alive behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: ASSIST employs a session time-out feature which logs you out when the system determines that there has been no activity for a specific amount of time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before automatic logout, ASSIST displays a warning indicating the remaining amount of time until logout; select 'Continue Working' from the warning screen to prevent the timeout.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forms version requirement (FORMS-I vs FORMS-H)
rubrics_metrics.description: The forms in these topics reflect FORMS-I, which must be used for applications with due dates on or after January 25, 2025 (see guide notice NOT-OD-24-086). For due dates on or before January 24, 2025, use FORMS-H.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the annotated form set and summary of changes for Forms-I and consult the How to Apply page for the appropriate Application Guide.
